newsitem.title: CHINA: China insurer recovers $200 mln trade debt.
newsitem.headline: China insurer recovers $200 mln trade debt.

text.p: The People's Insurance (Property) Co of China (PICC) has recovered $200 million in trading debts owed by an unidentified foreign country, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
Chinese traders and banks had failed to recover the debts that occurred in trading with the country, which was short of foreign exchange because of excessive imports, it said.
PICC Property, an export insurance provider to Chinese exporters, joined their efforts to recall the $200 million debts and finally recovered the money, it said.
PICC started export insurance business in 1988 and set up a special department to collect debts for its clients, it said.
